subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class default remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory facade now, route this to plugin/ClawHub surfaces, or wait for the companion memory schema/provenance/write-flow decisions first?
rationale: The current code has overlapping memory surfaces, but the requested command and skill facade depends on durable schema, provenance, review/edit/forget semantics, and the special memory plugin slot rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin First
options.body: Treat the need as satisfied by external memory plugins or ClawHub skills unless a missing SDK seam is identified.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Companion Issues
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide the command facade should be decomposed entirely into the open schema/provenance/write/review issues.

recommendation.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a memory product-boundary decision, and steipete is the strongest sampled product-boundary routing signal from the current issue timeline and prior memory review context.
